import sys
MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])  # k is read as long, but fits in int
    # Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to n
    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD
    inv = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv[n] = pow(fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD)
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        inv[i-1] = inv[i] * i % MOD
    def comb(i, j):
        if j < 0 or j > i:
            return 0
        return fact[i] * inv[j] % MOD * inv[i - j] % MOD

    if k == 0:
        print(fact[n])
    elif k > n:
        print(0)
    else:
        k2 = int(k)
        k3 = n - k2
        ans = 0
        for i in range(1, k3 + 1):
            tmp = comb(k3, i) * pow(i, n, MOD) % MOD
            if (k3 - i) & 1:
                ans -= tmp
            else:
                ans += tmp
        ans = (ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD
        ans = ans * 2 % MOD
        ans = ans * comb(n, k2) % MOD
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
